subject: POC success criteria & KPIs - Tribeca Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tribeca-payments.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@tribeca-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & KPIs - Tribeca Payments

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the POC / trial scope: 

1) Goal of POC: Validate Redwood inference for Tribeca's payments fraud-screening use case in production-like conditions and measure the unit economics + latency at scale.

2) Success criteria / KPIs (proposal):
   - Latency (p50/p95) for a 256-token prompt: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms (end-to-end inference call).
   - Throughput: sustained 120 rps for typical batch size (we'll confirm batch profile).
   - Cost: target <= $0.0035 per token (including batching/quantization benefits) at POC scale; provide baseline and POC projection.
   - Quality: precision@top1 >= 92% on your labeled fraud test set; false positive rate <= 1.5% (we'll use the eval set you mentioned).
   - Reliability: <1% error rate (5xx/timeout) over a 72-hour continuous run.

3) Evaluation plan:
   - Redwood provides a 2-week trial environment (dedicated instance) and test harness + a small sample load generator.
   - Tribeca provides the labeled eval set (anonymized) and a 72-hr traffic replay or synthetic generator that reflects peak QPS.
   - Joint benchmark run: day 3 (smoke), day 7 (full run), day 14 (final).

4) Ownership / contacts:
   - Redwood: Jordan (AE) — POC owner, Marissa (solutions engineer) — technical lead, Rishi (support lead) — infra/ops.
   - Tribeca: Alex (product) — success criteria sign-off, Priya (engineering) — test data & replay config, Procurement — procurement/contracting.

5) Timeline & next steps (proposed):
   - Today: confirm success criteria and owners (this thread).
   - By Fri, Jun 18: Tribeca to share anonymized eval set and preliminary replay config.
   - Mon, Jun 21: Redwood to deliver POC environment + initial benchmark plan (doc + two short runs).
   - Jun 22–25: Full 72-hr runs and analysis.

Attachments: I attached a first draft POC success plan (tribeca_poc_success_plan_v1.pdf) and expected latency benchmark template (latency_benchmarks.csv).

If this looks good, please reply with any edits and confirm we can start on Fri with the data handoff.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tribeca-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tribeca-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs - Tribeca Payments

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick thoughts: the latency/throughput targets look in the right ballpark. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Our production 99th percentile for similar models sits at ~700ms; if Redwood can deliver p95 <= 350ms on a 256-token prompt that's a meaningful improvement.
- For quality, we measure on our labeled fraud set (2,500 records). We'll share an anonymized subset of ~500 records first for the smoke run.
- Cost target: we'll want both per-token and per-inference estimates (since some calls are long). If you can provide modeled cost at 100k, 1M token volumes that'd help procurement.

We can commit to:
- Sharing anonymized sample dataset by Fri, Jun 18 (Priya will coordinate).
- Providing replay config by end of day Fri.

Two asks from procurement: include a provisional quote and a short statement on data handling (SOC2 + retention) to expedite contracting. Procurement cc'd (procurement@tribeca-payments.com).

— Alex
Alex Chen
Director, Product — Payments Risk
alex.chen@tribeca-payments.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tribeca-payments.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@tribeca-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@tribeca-payments.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs - Tribeca Payments

Alex / Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will action the items below. A few notes and an updated ask list so nothing falls between the cracks: 

- Cost modeling: Marissa will produce modeled cost per-token and per-inference at 100k and 1M token volumes; Rishi will include an ops note on how batching/quantization assumptions affect those numbers.
- Data handling: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant; I'll attach a short one-pager and include our retention defaults (30 days for KV cache by default, configurable).
- Benchmark plan: Marissa proposes the following schedule for the 72-hr run: kickoff and smoke (Day 1), ramp to target QPS Day 2, steady-state Day 3, then a 24-hr analysis window.

Please confirm these owners:
- Data handoff (anonymized eval set): Priya
- Replay config: Priya
- Procurement & quote: procurement@tribeca-payments.com
- Redwood POC environment & cost model: Marissa / Rishi

If that looks right I will kick off the POC setup once we get the sample dataset on Fri.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs - Tribeca Payments

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for confirming you'll send the sample set. A few technical details from our side to speed the runs: 

1) Data format: a CSV with columns [id, prompt, label] is perfect. Please remove any PCI auth fields — anonymized prompt text only.
2) Replay config: if you can provide a short JSON with timestamps & QPS profile that helps but a simple CSV with timestamp + example request is fine.
3) Test harness: we'll run the 72-hr job on a dedicated Redwood instance (we'll provide endpoint + credentials). For the smoke run we'll use a small sample (50 rps), then ramp as planned.

Preliminary benchmark expectations (internal note):
- Expected p50: ~95–120ms on our optimized variant at 256 tokens.
- Expected p95: ~280–330ms depending on burst patterns and cache warm-up.
- Cost estimate: modeled $0.0028/token at 1M token volume (inc. batching). We'll include a sliding table in the cost deck.

Next logistical steps:
- Priya: send sample dataset & replay config by EOD Fri (owner: Priya).
- Procurement: would you accept a provisional SOW and quote to start the POC while legal finishes the paperwork?
- Once we receive the data, Jordan will schedule a 30-min kickoff (propose Mon Jun 21 10:00 AM PT).

I'll upload the detailed POC plan to the Drive folder and share the link (see hubspot/deal link in the thread).

Thanks — looking forward to running this.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0178
